review.brief_reason: The rewrite reassociates/factors across gplearn protected division (e.g., 5*x2/x5 + 4*x4/x5 -> (5*x2+4*x4)/x5, and similarly inside the sin terms and the x1..x5 term). Under protected semantics div(a,b)=1 when |b|<=1e-3, so two separate protected divisions by x5 each return 1 (sum 2) while the merged single division returns 1; this changes values on the common real domain (protected div is total, so |x5|<=1e-3 is included). The same protected-region mismatch occurs in sin(x2+sin(...)), sin(5*(x2+x4)/x5) vs sin(5*x2/x5+5*x4/x5), and the consolidated /x5 term (original inner sums to 4 -> sin(4), proposed to 1 -> sin(1) at the test point). Net value gap far exceeds abs_tol/rel_tol.
review.counterexample: x1=1, x2=0, x3=0, x4=0, x5=0 (|x5|<=1e-3). Protected: 5*x2/x5+4*x4/x5 = div(0,0)+div(0,0) = 2 vs (5*x2+4*x4)/x5 = div(0,0) = 1. Also original big sin term = sin(4) ≈ -0.75680 while proposed = sin(1) ≈ 0.84147. Overall original - proposed ≈ -0.486, not within tolerance.
